name: manual_0f5406
claim: A guard in front of a service must act only on the endpoint the caller named. A request aimed at any other local port, such as a fake server in a test, must be refused, never served by the real engine.

decisions.notes: The gate treated every local address as its configured engine, so a test pointing at a dead port still caused a load on the real one.

rationale: The gate treated every local address as its configured engine, so a test pointing at a dead port still caused a load on the real one.
